Kishida said the clearest first step to show the LDP was changing was for him to step aside.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"August Opinion Polls Find Low Popularity for Kishida As He Ends His Term","publisher":"Nippon.com","date":"August 30, 2024","url":"https://www.nippon.com/en/japan-data/h30004/","summary":"Major August polls kept Kishida below 30% approval, with Jiji at 19.4% and NHK at 25%; respondents generally judged his decision to step down appropriate.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Statement by Prime Minister KISHIDA Fumio upon the General Resignation of the Kishida Cabinet","publisher":"Prime Minister's Office of Japan","date":"October 1, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202410/1001danwa.html","summary":"Kishida said the cabinet resigned en masse, portrayed his term as one of economic revival and defense strengthening, but acknowledged political fundraising issues had undermined trust.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Policy Speech by Prime Minister Kishida to the 213th Session of the Diet","publisher":"Prime Minister's Office of Japan","date":"January 30, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/30shiseihoshin.html","summary":"Kishida apologized over the LDP funding scandal, launched the Political Reform Headquarters, and promised transparency and legal reforms while also tying 2024 to wage growth, child support, and economic revitalization.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Japan's Kishida championed 'new capitalism' but was undone by yen","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 14, 2024","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SONY-GROUP-CORPORATION-6492482/news/Japan-s-Kishida-championed-new-capitalism-but-was-undone-by-yen-47649114/","summary":"Reuters said Kishida had pushed through some of Japan’s biggest wage increases in decades, but the weak yen, higher prices, and scandals outweighed that progress politically.","question_ids":[]}]}
